client_token.description: Client token returned by klarna host to initialize the payment process

payment_method_categories.description: Provides a list of available payment method categories at the time of checkout

items.title: Klarna Payment Method Category Object

identifier.description: The Identifier of the payment method category

name.description: Name of the Klarna payment method category

asset_urls.description: Asset URLs for the payment method provided by Klarna

items.description: Klarna available payment method category for a new payment credit transaction returned by Klarna Host

amount.description: Amount is charged without a decimal place e.g. $1.5 = 150. Currencies can have different decimals/exponentials, see Currencies Section for more details. For Account Verification transactions, provide 0 as value for this field.

blocked.description: True if the transaction has been blocked by a ruleset, false otherwise

created_by.description: The ID of the user who initiated the transaction. Only set when shopper_interaction = moto, mail_order or telephone_order

created_at.description: The time at which the transaction was created.

merchant_reference.description: A reference specified by the merchant to identify the transaction.

processor.description: The name of the processor used for this transaction

payment_product.description: The payment product corresponding to this transaction

status.description: The outcome of the payment request.
status.title: Ecommerce Transaction Status

status_reason.description: Message provided by the 3rd party service as additional information, when the transaction does not succeed.

shopper_interaction.description:
Determines the sales channel the shopper gives their card details through:

 * `ECOMMERCE` Online transactions where the cardholder is present.

 * `MAIL` order transactions where the shopper is in contact with the merchant via email.

 * `TELEPHONE` order transactions where the shopper is in contact with the merchant via telephone.

geo_location.description: The latitude / longitude resolved from the customer's ip address.

city.description: The city resolved from the customer's ip address.

country_code.title: Country Code
country_code.description:
The [ISO 3166-1 alpha-2](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1_alpha-2) country code.
Note: The country code for Great Britain is GB and not UK as is used in that country's top-level domain names.
.
